name: Jay Mark Piano
bio: Leads the overall software engineering and technical direction of BuildLab. Connects the user interface with the 3D PC builder, real-time compatibility checks, and backend database systems.
fav_tip: Never cheap out on your power supply. An efficient Tier-A PSU protects your entire PC from sudden power spikes and keeps all parts running safely.

name: Judiel Gollena
bio: Designs and crafts how BuildLab looks and feels. Engineered the sleek obsidian dark theme, interactive navigation drawers, tactile audio effects, and mobile responsive layouts.
fav_tip: Assemble your motherboard, CPU, RAM, and SSD on top of the motherboard box before putting them inside the PC case. It gives you plenty of room to work safely.

name: Andrei Jose Tuazon
fav_tip: Always remember to remove the clear plastic protective film from the bottom of your CPU cooler before applying thermal paste and installing it!

name: Shin Ariane Pol
bio: Writes, organizes, and maintains all project documentation, thesis manuals, research papers, system user guides, and ISO/IEC 25010 academic compliance instruments.
fav_tip: Always double-check your part dimensions and cable layout before screwing down the motherboard into your PC case.

name: Lorenz Tejado
bio: Engineered BuildLab's normalized MySQL relational database, RESTful Express backend services, crawler integration pipeline, and authentication security.
fav_tip: Dual-channel memory goes into slots 2 and 4 (A2/B2). Check your motherboard's PCB silkscreen to ensure maximum signal trace impedance.
